announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.intro: Compose and publish school notices, targeted by role or class, now or on a schedule.

compose.mandatory: Mandatory — recipients cannot disable this notice
compose.publishAtHelp: Leave blank to publish immediately. Uses your device’s local time zone — converted to a fixed instant, so recipients see it at the same moment everywhere.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Configure your profile, school defaults, invitation and attendance policy, and storage.
settings.loadError: Unable to load school settings. Try reloading the page.

validation.invalidTimezone: Must be a valid IANA timezone (e.g. Africa/Casablanca).
validation.wholeHours: Enter a whole number of hours.
validation.maxHours: Must be 8760 hours (1 year) or fewer.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How you show up to other staff, students, and parents across the portal.
profile.displayNameHelp: Shown instead of your email wherever your name appears in the portal.
profile.emailHelp: Your sign-in email. Changing it isn't supported from this screen.
profile.roleHelp: Assigned by another admin from the Users screen, not editable here.

locale.title: Locale and timezone
locale.description: Default language and timezone for this school, used in emails, the portal, and timetable rendering.
locale.languageHelp: Applied to system emails and the portal's default language for new users.
locale.timezoneHelp: IANA timezone, e.g. Africa/Casablanca. Used to render the timetable and schedule alerts.

grading.title: Grading scheme
grading.description: How grades are displayed across report cards and gradebooks school-wide.
grading.label: Grading scheme
grading.help: Changes how every existing grade is labeled, not just new ones.
grading.confirmBody: This changes how every existing grade at this school is displayed — from {{from}} to {{to}}. It takes effect immediately across every report card and gradebook.

attendance.title: Attendance alerts
attendance.description: Thresholds that trigger attendance alerts, the teacher correction window, and discipline visibility for parents.
attendance.attendanceThresholdHelp: An alert fires when a student's attendance rate falls below this percentage.
attendance.absenceThresholdHelp: An alert fires when a student's absence rate rises above this percentage.
attendance.correctionWindowHelp: How long after a session teachers can still correct its attendance. After it, only a principal can.
attendance.parentVisibility: Parents can view their child's resolved discipline incidents
attendance.showBody: Every parent at this school will immediately be able to see their own child's resolved discipline incidents in the portal.
attendance.hideBody: Parents will immediately lose access to their child's resolved discipline incidents in the portal.

exams.title: Exam system
exams.description: How every term is examined. Subjects are set up from this, so teachers enter exactly these parts each term.

systems.midterm: Midterm exam and final exam, plus quizzes and homework
systems.periods: First period exam, second period exam and final exam, plus quizzes and homework

exams.weightsHelp: Each part is marked out of its share: a 30% midterm is out of 30. Set a part to 0 to leave it out.
exams.applyHelp: Rebuilds every subject of the current academic year on this system. Subjects that already have marks are left as they are.
exams.saveBeforeApply: Save your changes before applying them to subjects.
exams.confirmTitle: Apply the exam system to all subjects?
exams.confirmBody: Every subject of the current academic year without marks gets this system's parts for each term, replacing its current categories and assessments. Subjects that already have marks are not changed.
exams.resultUpdated: {{count}} subjects in {{year}} now use this system.
exams.resultHasMarks: Not changed because they already have marks: {{subjects}}.
exams.resultOther: Not changed (set these up in Academic Setup): {{subjects}}.
